title: Allocation of Distribution Margins to Patron Accounts — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital)
content:
# Allocation of Distribution Margins to Patron Accounts

**Board policy, Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** In the allocation month of each year — June in every patron class — the prior patronage year's distribution margins are allocated to every member who was billed in the class during that year.

## Allocation clauses

1. **Amount.** The allocation is the class's allocation rate, as a percent, of the member's patronage revenue in the class, rounded to the cent. Patronage revenue in the class is the total of the usage lines billed in the billing periods January through December of the patronage year, on every service account of the member whose rate schedule belongs to the class, less the sales tax on them; fees and program charges are not patronage revenue.
2. **Wholesale supplier pass-through.** Where the class passes through the wholesale supplier's capital credits (every class does), the wholesale supplier's allocation to Cedar Fork for the same year is passed through to the member as a separate wholesale-supplier allocation, in proportion to the same patronage, its amount being taken from the allocation notice as recorded.
3. **Members who left.** A member who left during the year is still allocated for the months billed.
4. **Open accounts only.** Allocations may be booked only on a capital account in active, inactive or estate claim pending status, as the account's status shows in the system record. The first allocation in a class opens the member's capital account in that class.
5. **Member type.** Accounts in each class are held by members of any member type — individual, joint, business, nonprofit or government.
6. **Notice.** Allocations are notified on the annual statement sent with the June bill. An allocation is not cash and is never paid out until it is retired.

## Allocation records

Each allocation is recorded on the capital account as one entry per allocation year per allocation source — the distribution-margin allocation and the wholesale-supplier allocation are separate entries — showing the date booked, the patronage year, the source, the patronage revenue it rests on and the amount allocated.

## Worked examples (hypothetical revenue figures)

| Patron class | Allocation rate | Patronage revenue in the year | Distribution-margin allocation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Farm Patron Class | 4.12 percent | $2,450.00 | $100.94 |
| Irrigation Patron Class | 3.21 percent | $5,380.17 | $172.70 (172.7035 rounded to the cent) |

A member billed on Schedule FH and Schedule IR in the same year receives both allocations, each on its own class account, and each class's wholesale-supplier pass-through as a further separate entry.

## Status check (truth table)

| Account status | Allocation may be booked |
|---|---|
| active | Yes |
| inactive | Yes |
| estate claim pending | Yes |
| fully retired | No |
